summary: Created `srvdata_vg/srvdata_lv`, mounted it at `/srv/data`, and grew it online from 1 GiB to 2.5 GiB without changing the proof file. Boot-time loop/LVM activation and mounting were configured and successfully validated across a node restart.
actions_performed: Created a persistent file-backed LVM physical volume, volume group, and logical volume.
Formatted the LV as ext4 and mounted it read-write at `/srv/data`.
Created an integrity proof file before growth.
Extended the mounted LV online from 1 GiB to 2.5 GiB.
Configured systemd units for early loop/LVM activation and persistent mounting.
Restarted node1 and verified changed boot identity, recovered services, mount, LV size, and data integrity.

evidence.requirement: Provide a logical volume mounted at `/srv/data`
evidence.summary: Created `srvdata_vg/srvdata_lv`, formatted it as ext4, and mounted it at `/srv/data`.

evidence.requirement: Grow the logical volume to at least 2 GB while mounted and preserve its contents
evidence.summary: Online resize increased the LV from 1.00 GiB to 2.50 GiB; `/srv/data` remained mounted and the pre-growth SHA-256 hash was unchanged.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID `b0d3...`, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed disconnection, then observed changed boot ID `6875...`. Post-restart evidence shows both units active, `/srv/data` mounted read-write, the LV at 2560 MiB, and the original file content/hash intact.
